title: Mom's Misinformation Machine: source-checked release expansion proposals
scope: 21 additional unique subjects beyond the twelve-card starter. Original concise wording, source-backed precise propositions; not a comprehensive conspiracy catalog.
classification_policy: documented maps to Documented; unsupported and contradicted map to Unsupported claim. Preserve exact evidence status in explanations; no disputed or unresolved statements included.
release_policy: Source-checked proposals for authorized release integration by the release captain; no additional human approval gate is imposed here.
rarity_policy: Editorial iceberg tiers are proposals; no real player answer-frequency data is claimed.
